description: Three side-by-side isoplethal (vertical) sections — calculated CALPHAD phase diagrams — for a quaternary Fe-Mn-C-Al alloy of nominal composition 8Mn-0.2C (wt.%). Every panel plots temperature T (°C) on the y-axis (labelled 600 to 1400 in 100 °C steps) against wt.-% Al on the x-axis (labelled 0 to 10 at each integer). In-panel headers read "Database: PreHiMn-01" (a), "Database: PreHiMn-02" (b) and "Database: PreHiMn-03" (c); the caption maps these to the Hallstedt database incorporating the Chin et al. assessment, the Umino et al. assessment, and the assessment by Lindahl and Selleby, respectively. (a) is the richest panel: an FCC single-phase field at low Al, plus BCC+CEMENTITE+FCC, BCC+FCC, BCC+FCC+κ, BCC+M5C2, BCC+FCC+M5C2, BCC+FCC+κ+M5C2, BCC+κ, BCC+κ+M5C2 and Liquid+BCC. (b) is the simplest, resolving only FCC, BCC+FCC, BCC+FCC+κ and LIQUID+BCC. (c) shows FCC, BCC+FCC, BCC+FCC+κ, BCC+CEMENTITE+FCC (low Al) and BCC+κ (high Al). All three agree that a Liquid+BCC field occupies the top-right corner above roughly 1350-1400 °C. The figure demonstrates that the three databases differ mainly in their low-temperature equilibria: only (a) and (c) retain cementite, and only (a) retains M5C2.

subfigures.description: Isoplethal section, y-axis T (°C) 600-1400, x-axis wt.-% Al 0-10, headed "Database: PreHiMn-01". Shows the largest number of phase fields of the three panels: FCC, BCC+CEMENTITE+FCC, BCC+FCC, BCC+FCC+κ, BCC+M5C2, BCC+FCC+M5C2, BCC+FCC+κ+M5C2, BCC+κ, BCC+κ+M5C2 and Liquid+BCC. Dense low-temperature field boundaries below about 900 °C with many leader-line labels.

Isoplethal section with identical axes, headed "Database: PreHiMn-02". Simplest panel: only FCC (large low-Al/low-T field), LIQUID+BCC (top right), BCC+FCC and BCC+FCC+κ are labelled. No cementite or M5C2 field appears.

Isoplethal section with identical axes, headed "Database: PreHiMn-03". Fields labelled FCC, Liquid+BCC, BCC+FCC, BCC+FCC+κ (labelled with an arrow), BCC+CEMENTITE+FCC (narrow low-Al strip just above 600 °C) and BCC+κ (bottom right). No M5C2 field.

observations.observation: The figure is a set of three isoplethal sections for a quaternary alloy plotted as temperature T (°C), 600-1400 in 100 °C increments, versus wt.-% Al, 0-10 in integer steps.
The three panels carry the in-panel headers 'Database: PreHiMn-01' (a), 'Database: PreHiMn-02' (b) and 'Database: PreHiMn-03' (c).
Panel (a) contains the phase-field labels FCC, BCC + CEMENTITE + FCC, BCC + FCC, BCC + FCC + κ, BCC + M5C2, BCC + FCC + M5C2, BCC + FCC + κ + M5C2, BCC + κ, BCC + κ + M5C2 and Liquid + BCC.
Panel (b) is the least-resolved of the three: only FCC, LIQUID + BCC, BCC + FCC and BCC + FCC + κ are labelled, with no cementite or M5C2 field.
Panel (c) labels FCC, Liquid + BCC, BCC + FCC, BCC + FCC + κ, BCC + CEMENTITE + FCC and BCC + κ, and therefore predicts cementite but not M5C2.
A Liquid + BCC phase field occupies the top-right corner of all three panels, appearing above roughly 1350-1400 °C at 0 wt.-% Al and reaching down to about 1250-1300 °C near 10 wt.-% Al.
The FCC single-phase field is broadest in panel (b), extending to about 5 wt.-% Al at the lowest plotted temperatures, whereas in (a) and (c) it is bounded at lower Al.
The BCC + FCC + κ three-phase field is the only phase field labelled in all three panels.

The caption identifies the three calculations as isoplethal sections of a quaternary 8Mn-0.2C (wt.%) alloy produced with the Hallstedt database incorporating, respectively, the Chin et al., Umino et al., and Lindahl and Selleby assessments.
The citing text states that 'Figure 2 shows a comparison of isoplethal sections calculated with these three databases'.

The citing text asserts that at low temperatures thermodynamics predicts austenite in a two-phase structure should decompose into ferrite and the 'j-phase' (Fig. 2c); the figure itself labels no phase as 'j' — panel (c) shows a BCC + CEMENTITE + FCC field at low Al, so the naming may not correspond exactly to the plotted labels.
The figure contains no printed numeric composition, temperature or phase-fraction values on the phase boundaries — all values must be read against the gridlines.

unreadable_items: Exact phase-boundary positions/compositions are not printed; boundaries can only be located approximately against the 100 °C and 1 wt.-% gridlines
The dense cluster of low-temperature field boundaries and leader-line labels in panel (a) below ~750 °C and between ~3 and 8 wt.-% Al is crowded and partly overlapping at the supplied resolution
